generation.notes: Leaf and stem generated with genuine alpha. Branch transparent attempts retained for reproducibility but rejected for incorrect matte/glow; accepted branch uses the sprite skill magenta cleanup workflow.

leaf.mirrorRule: For the opposite side reflect all x coordinates as width-x.
leaf.postprocess: Horizontal mirror, Lanczos resize to 512x320, remove disconnected alpha specks while retaining 2px antialias fringe.

repeat.policy: Align endpoint sockets; 1 source pixel overlap. End-strip crossfade is baked into this seamless export.

stem.postprocess: Remove disconnected alpha specks; Lanczos resize384x512; register both32px end strips to114px opaque width centered192 with smooth64px transition bands; crossfade generated strips in premultiplied alpha, remove duplicate32px strip, resize vertically to512; normalize final endpoints114px centered192. Lossless PNG/WebP.
stem.notes: Exactly two substantial intertwined stems. Source opaque endpoint width is2x the original stem's57px. Two small tendrils; no new leaf platforms or runtime code.

branch.defaultDirection: thick stem socket left, tapered leaf socket right
branch.postprocess: Sprite skill process single asset, largest component, threshold100 edgeThreshold150; crop [360,190,1704,550], resize240x64, paste[8,16] in256x96 canvas, remove disconnected alpha specks.

repeat.policy: Align endpoint sockets; slight overlap masks natural paint seam.

originalStem.postprocess: Lanczos resize to 256x512, remove disconnected alpha specks while retaining 2px antialias fringe.

validation.visualInspection: Leaf and stem inspected on gray; branch checked after magenta cleanup. Runtime composition is owned by the integrating agent.
validation.alpha: All final files RGBA with alpha range0..255; isolated non-subject alpha components removed.
validation.pngWebpParity: Composites identical on gray and white in export-assets.py.
validation.actorSafety: Broad unobstructed leaf surface. Tiny stem buds/tendrils only. Draw all three behind actor sprites.
